title: A column-wise limit of orthogonal projections onto n-planes is the orthogonal projection onto an n-plane
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and E := ℝ^P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P), written Euclid P) with standard basis e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1 (i < P). For a subspace V ⊆ E let p_V := V.starProjection be the orthogonal projection onto V. Let (S_j)_{j∈ℕ} be subspaces of E with dim S_j = n (Module.finrank ℝ S_j = n) for every j. Let w_0, …, w_{P−1} ∈ E (a family w : Fin P → E) be such that p_{S_j} e_i → w_i as j → ∞ for every i < P. Then there is a subspace S' ⊆ E with dim S' = n (Module.finrank ℝ S' = n) and p_{S'} e_i = w_i for every i < P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : ℕ → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (w : Fin P → Euclid P), (∀ j, Module.finrank ℝ (S j) = n) → (∀ i : Fin P, Tendsto (fun j => (S j).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 (w i))) → ∃ S' : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ S' = n ∧ ∀ i : Fin P, S'.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = w i
